A patio designed around your garden

No two gardens are the same. We start by finding out how you want to use the space:

  • Dining and entertaining – room for a table, chairs and a barbecue.
  • Relaxing – a quiet spot in the sun, or in the shade.
  • Linking the house and garden – a smooth step out from the back door or patio doors.
  • Making a small garden work harder – a neat patio can make a compact garden feel bigger and easier to look after.

We then help you choose the size, shape, layout and finish to suit your home [PLACEHOLDER: confirm patio materials offered].

How we lay your patio

  1. Free visit and quote

    We look at your garden, talk through your ideas and give you a clear, no-obligation quote.

  2. Agreeing the design

    We confirm the layout and finish with you before work begins.

  3. Preparing the ground

    The area is cleared, dug out and levelled so your patio has a solid base.

  4. Laying the patio

    Laid carefully, with neat joints, cuts and edges.

  5. Finishing and tidy-up

    We clean up and leave your garden ready to enjoy.

Patio FAQs

How much does a new patio cost?

The price depends on the size, the finish you choose, the condition of the ground and access to your garden. We will give you a free, no-obligation quote after a quick visit.

How long does it take to lay a patio?

Most patios take a few days [PLACEHOLDER: confirm typical patio duration]. We will give you a timescale with your quote.
